stdio_configured_cap.finding: AsyncRwTransport::new already has a 16 MiB incoming-line bound; the default JsonRpcMessageCodec max_length of usize::MAX does not make that stdin reader unbounded.
stdio_configured_cap.change: Use SDK AsyncRwTransport::new_server(...).with_max_line_length(cli.max_request_bytes) so the same configured budget bounds HTTP request bodies and complete stdin lines, including LF or CRLF.
stdio_configured_cap.mechanism: SDK read_line checks length before appending bytes or parsing JSON and discards oversized lines through their terminator with cancellation-safe state. No custom parser or new stdout logging was added.
stdio_configured_cap.coverage: Configured limit-1, limit and limit+1 with LF and CRLF; following valid frame recovery; cancelled receive during discard; 2 MiB invalid UTF-8 input streamed through a bounded duplex buffer. This is behavioral framing coverage, not an allocation/RSS measurement.

limits_and_follow_up: The coordinator owns the final integrated all-feature, compatibility and documentation gates; these scoped results do not assert a final repository-wide test count.
SCITT submission returns explicitly unverified receipt bytes. No RFC 9942 VDS inclusion, consistency, transparency-service identity or trust-policy verification is claimed.
Old nominal managed-model stores and version-1 standalone semantic indexes require an old compatible reader or reembedding into a new store; metadata relabeling is rejected.
Historical benchmark raw values remain preserved. Invalid RSS and unknown source revisions cannot support performance wins; live reruns remain necessary to establish current performance.
HTTP bounds are finite transport/admission/replay budgets rather than an RSS benchmark or exactly-once mutation guarantee. Interrupted mutation responses require state/version reconciliation.
The rmcp 3.7 session manager maps capacity errors to HTTP 500. Global HTTP request overload returns 503; legacy clients must renew expired or retired sessions.
Production model quality, full-size inference memory/throughput, live registries, remote transparency services and release publication were not exercised.
